title: DcsaTransportCallSubscriptionBody
description:
Transport call subscription filters.

Source: `transportCallSubscriptionBody` schema in the DCSA Event Domain (v3.1.0).

transportCallReference.description: Filters to only receive events for a specific transport call.

vesselIMONumber.description: Filters to only receive events for a specific vessel IMO number.

carrierExportVoyageNumber.description: Filters to only receive events for a specific carrier export voyage number.

universalExportVoyageReference.description: Filters to only receive events for a specific universal export voyage reference.

carrierServiceCode.description: Filters to only receive events for a specific carrier service code.

universalServiceReference.description: Filters to only receive events for a specific universal service reference.

UNLocationCode.description: Filters to only receive events for a specific UN/LOCODE.
